name: Diamine oxidase (DAO) enzyme supplements
short: Migraine trial in 100 people with low DAO levels: no adverse effects registered with the DAO supplement over one month. Other DAO trial abstracts do not report adverse events.
text: Diamine oxidase (DAO) is an enzyme that breaks down histamine; these data are for DAO food supplements taken by mouth. In a randomised, double-blind trial in 100 people with episodic migraine and DAO deficiency, given a DAO supplement or placebo for one month, adverse effects were among the outcomes assessed, and no adverse effects were registered in patients given DAO. The abstracts of a 22-person placebo-controlled crossover study in chronic urticaria (30 days of oral DAO capsules), a 100-woman placebo-controlled trial in fibromyalgia (8 weeks) and a 28-person open-label pilot study in histamine intolerance (4 weeks of capsules before meals) do not report adverse events either way. These are short, small studies, and long-term safety data were not found. No interaction data were found in the cited sources.
